title: "They're Not FBI by the Way": The DA Who Vouched

lines.say: They're not F.B.I., by the way. That's what a Mississippi district attorney told his city's mayor about two developers, according to the indictment.
lines.show: "They're not FBI by the way." That's what a Mississippi district attorney told his city's mayor about two developers, according to the indictment.

lines.say: They were. Both worked for the F.B.I.

scene.src: Indictment, U.S. v. Owens, Lumumba & Banks (S.D. Miss. 3:24-cr-103)

lines.say: The indictment says district attorney Jody Owens took a hundred twenty-five thousand dollars in cash on a yacht, and told them: Everybody needs something fixed.
lines.show: The indictment says district attorney Jody Owens took $125,000 in cash on a yacht, and told them: "Everybody needs something fixed."

scene.src: Indictment, U.S. v. Owens, Lumumba & Banks (S.D. Miss. 3:24-cr-103)

lines.say: He steered fifty thousand to the mayor.

scene.src: Indictment, U.S. v. Owens, Lumumba & Banks (S.D. Miss. 3:24-cr-103)

lines.say: Owens pleaded guilty. Forty-one months, and a hundred-thousand-dollar fine.
lines.show: Owens pleaded guilty. 41 months, and a $100,000 fine.
